style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for the worn packshot and the detail pair, mint #CBE3D5 claim and trust fields, lotus-pink #EFDDD8 macro field, one bright beach and one misty conifer trail for the two scene shots
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line glyphs inside rounded-square tiles, plus hollow curved airflow arrows in the accent tint; flat, no 3D, no glossy badges, no digits
style.lightingSystem: bright high-key studio light from a large front softbox with a low-power fill card; outdoor scenes run a hard 6000K daylight key with unseen bounce; fabric weave opened only with skimming light
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool mint sun-apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, mint #CBE3D5, lotus-pink #EFDDD8 and deep pine #2C4A41; bright high-key studio lighting from a large front softbox with a low-power fill card, hard 6000K daylight only in the two outdoor scenes, skimming light only for fabric texture; modern geometric sans-serif with headline and label slots kept as placeholders and every value left as a blank strip; thin single-weight line glyphs in rounded-square tiles with flat hollow airflow arrows; real fabric drape with visible topstitch and matte finish; stable slight 3/4 worn angle with brim, stand collar and front zipper readable; generous negative space reserved for copy; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no index numbers or rating badges, no identifiable faces.
noDrift: no protection index numbers, rating badges or percentage marks
no identifiable model faces or retouched skin
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 worn angle with the stiff extended brim, stand collar and front zipper always readable; garment never hidden by props; no identifiable face in any frame, head cropped above the jaw or shaded by the brim and face flap; fabric kept matte with visible topstitch
style.surfaceSystem: sand strip #E6DCC9 underfoot in the beach scene, matte lotus-pink board #EFDDD8 for the macro field, seamless white #FFFFFF floor elsewhere
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; one headline slot plus a few short label slots, every rendered word carried by a placeholder and every measurement left as a blank strip
